title: Auditing Chinese Web-scale Corpora via Sampled BPE Token Statistics
abstract: arXiv:2608.10678v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chinese web pollution has surfaced in LLMs, motivating audits of upstream Chinese corpora. However, auditing such corpora faces three challenges: (1) their web-scale size makes full scan costly; (2) prior analyses are often too coarse to expose token-level pollution; (3) Chinese web pollution is implicit and rapidly changing. We propose Sampled-BPE, a lightweight token-level auditing pipeline that sample a small subset and train BPE tokenizer to surface polluted tokens. Experiments show that Sampled-BPE preserves usable estimates while substantially reducing runtime and memory: a 148.4 $\times$ speedup and a 35.8 $\times$ memory reduction induce only 4.25% relative error for pollution categories. We apply the pipeline to 11 open Chinese corpora and 6 Chinese Common Crawl snapshots from 2021 to 2026. The audit reveals widespread but uneven pollution across open corpora, as well as highly polluted and temporally shifting Chinese

translated_title: 通过采样BPE词元统计审计中文网络规模语料库
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.10678v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要： 中文网络污染已在大型语言模型（LLM）中显现，这促使人们对上游中文语料库进行审计。然而，对此类语料库的审计面临三大挑战：（1）其网络级规模使得全量扫描成本高昂；（2）先前的分析往往过于粗糙，无法暴露词元级别的污染；（3）中文网络污染具有隐蔽性且快速变化。我们提出了Sampled-BPE，一个轻量级的词元级审计流水线，通过采样小规模子集并训练BPE分词器来显现受污染的词元。实验表明，Sampled-BPE在大幅降低运行时间和内存占用的同时，仍能保持可用的估计精度：148.4倍的加速和35.8倍的内存降低仅带来污染类别4.25%的相对误差。我们将该流水线应用于11个开放中文语料库以及2021年至2026年的6个中文Common Crawl快照。审计结果显示，开放语料库中存在广泛但不均匀的污染，以及污染程度高且随时间演变的中文网络内容。
tldr: 提出轻量级词元级审计流水线Sampled-BPE，通过采样小规模子集并训练BPE分词器高效检测中文网络语料库污染，实现148.4倍加速且仅引入4.25%相对误差，并揭示开放中文语料库中普遍存在且随时间演变的污染问题。
en_tdlr: Sampled-BPE is a lightweight token-level auditing pipeline that trains BPE tokenizers on small sampled subsets to efficiently detect pollution in Chinese web-scale corpora, achieving a 148.4× speedup with only 4.25% relative error, and revealing widespread and temporally shifting pollution across open Chinese corpora.
